prose: Vibe Rant regular Jorge Mesa of Third Eye Edify returns tonight to talk about his brand new book, World War You, a deep dive into the diverse and devious deceptions that have been weaponized for use on the first and last frontier of human conflict, the mind. Tying together a tremendous quantity of topics, including dinosaurs, Hollywood, video games, ad campaigns, shadow figures and the robotization of mankind, we'll be taking the fight to the only place that can make a real difference: our world-view.
